title: Fourteenth Study
summary: An unconstrained image study used to test composition, material contrast, and how much atmosphere could be built inside a single frame.

seo.title: Fourteenth Study project
seo.description: Personal still-image study exploring atmosphere, material contrast, and composition.

caseStudy.hook: A loose study with no production constraint, useful mainly as a reference for instinct and taste.
brief: The value of this piece is less in the subject and more in the way the frame holds together under stylized lighting.

sections.title: What it tests
body: This frame tests how much detail can be implied rather than stated.
It also serves as a quick benchmark for color restraint and focal hierarchy.

outcomes: A lightweight visual benchmark for future still-image work
